signals.name: AIRBAG crash order
signals.note: Both AIRBAG bytes read as one 16-bit value

choices.1: 01 = driver seat belt not fastened (switch closed)
01 = passenger seat belt not fastened (switch closed)

choices.2: 010 = Reserved (formerly used by the robotized gearbox)

choices.0: 0 = Foot on the brake not needed
choices.1: 1 = Foot on the brake needed (automatic gearbox lever locked, or start with a gear engaged

choices.2: 01xx = oil temperature alert (automatic gearbox) or clutch overheating (robotized gearbox)
